known_limitations: Implements a lightweight prototype with in-memory state loaded from and saved to a JSON file rather than a full database.
Covers a representative subset of the reviewed requirements, including dashboard, search, item creation, glossary lookup, conflicts, and import staging.
Does not implement authentication, SSO, persistent multi-user locking, or real external repository/issue-tracker integrations.
Does not provide a full GUI; the delivered interface is JSON over HTTP.
Does not implement complete version history, notification delivery, or all workflow states described in the specification.
